manual.title: Manual Setup
manual.description: Enter the details for your Gree heat pump

reconfigure.title: Change address
reconfigure.description: Enter the heat pump's new IP address. It's checked before saving: the device at that address must answer, and it must be the same heat pump.

read_properties.name: Read properties
read_properties.description: Reads properties from the heat pump by name and returns what it answers. Read-only: it never changes anything on the heat pump. Names the heat pump doesn't know are listed under no_reply.

properties.name: Properties
properties.description: Property names to read, for example OutEnvTem. You can also enter several separated by commas.

config_entry_id.name: Heat pump
config_entry_id.description: Only needed if more than one heat pump is set up.
